description: This file defines an abstract base class 'SystemTarget' for various system services within the Orleans runtime, such as grain directory, reminder service, etc. It includes methods for message handling, timer registration, component management, and lifecycle control. The class is part of the Orleans.Runtime namespace and interacts with system messaging, scheduling, and extension mechanisms.

classes.name: SystemTarget
classes.description: An abstract base class for system services within Orleans (e.g., grain directory, reminder service). Provides common functionality such as message handling, timer registration, component management, and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a component of the specified type from the system target.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Sets or removes a component of the specified type for the system target.

methods.name: HandleNewRequest
methods.description: Handles an incoming request message and invokes the RuntimeClient.

methods.name: HandleResponse
methods.description: Handles a response message received by the system target.

methods.name: RegisterTimer
methods.description: Registers a recurring timer callback to this system target.

methods.name: RegisterGrainTimer
methods.description: Registers a GrainTimer callback, with overloads supporting different callback signatures.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the system target.

methods.name: ToDetailedString
methods.description: Returns detailed string info about current message processing state.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives and processes an incoming message, routing request and response messages appropriately.

methods.name: GetTarget
methods.description: Returns the current object cast to a specific target type.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the system target with a request context and cancellation token.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the system target with a reason and cancellation token.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: A task that completes when deactivation is complete.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up and stops all timers, updates system target counters.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Supports rehydration from a context; migration not supported.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Supports migration; no-op in current implementation.

methods.name: OnTimerCreated
methods.description: Callback for when a timer is created.

methods.name: OnTimerDisposed
methods.description: Callback for when a timer is disposed.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeContext
methods.description: Ensures current runtime context matches this system target, throws exception if not.

methods.name: GetOrSetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a system target extension/component.

methods.name: GetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a specific grain extension component.
